items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: I goes around to the Secretary of the Med, Mike Rooney. He said, oh, Mr. Mike. I said, I got there.

ctx.x: Well, I was playing the band, not the, I'm not being in the band, but the Ori is. Well, they signed up, go to play the band. So, following Tuesday, I goes around to the Secretary of the Med, Mike Rooney. He said, oh, Mr. Mike. I said, I got there. He said, oh, don't worry about that. He says, they're gonna have your last recommendation. He says, you'll be better off over in Camp Pike. You'll go over there and you'll organize your band.
